svg.title: Foundation-model benchmark: do single-cell foundation models help predict knockdown responses in an unseen cell line?
svg.desc: Four-column schematic: data (five source cell lines with known knockdown responses; Jurkat or HepG2 held out), representation of each line's control cells (raw profile or scGPT, Geneformer, State), prediction as a similarity-weighted average of source responses, and pre-registered evaluation with the challenge gate's metric.

g.text: The model sees its control cells only;
measured responses are used for scoring.
knockdown responses of Jurkat or HepG2.
Vectors centred on the five sources
over sources that measured knockdown k
LFC = log2 fold change vs that line's controls
